hunt.justification: wp2shell (CVE-2026-63030) is a critical, unauthenticated RCE chain actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV). Patching the core does not remove accounts or plugins created during a prior compromise; this hunt is the only way to verify the remediation of the payload itself.

scenario.summary: Attackers exploit a logic flaw in the WordPress REST API batch processor (CVE-2026-63030) to trigger route confusion, enabling a SQL injection (CVE-2026-60137) via the author__not_in parameter. Successful exploitation allows for unauthenticated creation of administrator accounts, which are subsequently used to log in and upload malicious plugins for full remote code execution.

meta.rationale: The hunt targets WordPress servers running vulnerable versions (6.9.0-6.9.4 and 7.0.0-7.0.1). High-value assets like public-facing web servers should be the primary focus.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker has used the wp2shell exploit chain to create an unauthorized administrator account, deploy a malicious plugin, and execute system commands from the web server process.

hunt.name: wp2shell: Privileged Access and Code Execution
hunt.description: Following the initial exploitation of CVE-2026-63030 and CVE-2026-60137, an attacker gains privileged access to the WordPress dashboard. This hunt identifies the 'payload' phase: the creation of new administrator sessions, the upload of malicious PHP code disguised as plugins, and the subsequent execution of system shells or utilities. By correlating software inventory for vulnerable WordPress versions with anomalous file writes to the plugins directory and rare child processes spawned by PHP/Nginx/Apache, the hunt provides high-fidelity evidence of host compromise. It specifically looks for the desynchronization of the REST API handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to operate as administrators.

nodes.label: Web server processes spawning shell utilities

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%php%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%httpd%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%nginx%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%apache%') AND (instr(',' || '{{shell_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_path) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/sh' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/bash' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/cmd.exe') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Detect the final stage of the RCE where the PHP process or web server launches an interactive shell or downloader utility.
config.expected_signal: Actionable evidence of system command execution by the web application. Any hit is high-fidelity.

primitive_config.label: Web server processes spawning shell utilities
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%php%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%httpd%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%nginx%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%apache%') AND (instr(',' || '{{shell_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_path) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/sh' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/bash' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/cmd.exe') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

nodes.label: Rare child processes of web servers

config.content: SELECT parent_process_name, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, COUNT(*) AS runs, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%php%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%httpd%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%nginx%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%apache%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY parent_process_name, process_name HAVING hosts <= 2 ORDER BY hosts ASC
config.description: Identify anomalous binaries launched by the web server that may have been renamed or aren't in standard lists.
config.expected_signal: Rare binaries (like 'nc' or custom wrappers) running only on one or two hosts in the fleet.

primitive_config.label: Rare child processes of web servers
primitive_config.content: SELECT parent_process_name, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, COUNT(*) AS runs, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%php%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%httpd%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%nginx%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%apache%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY parent_process_name, process_name HAVING hosts <= 2 ORDER BY hosts ASC
primitive_config.expected: Rare binaries (like 'nc' or custom wrappers) running only on one or two hosts in the fleet.

nodes.label: Unexpected PHP file writes in plugin directories

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_path, file_name, process_name, activity_id, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/wp-content/plugins/%.php' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\\wp-content\\plugins\\%.php') AND activity_id IN (1, 3) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Monitor the creation or modification of PHP files in sensitive WordPress directories, which is the primary persistence mechanism.
config.expected_signal: PHP file creation/overwrite by the web server process rather than an authorized update tool.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_path, src_endpoint_ip, status_code, user_agent, COUNT(*) as request_count, MIN(time) as first_request, MAX(time) as last_request FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%wp-login.php%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/wp-admin/%') AND status_code = 200 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, url_path, src_endpoint_ip, status_code, user_agent
